item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Corrosive Chemical Transfer
item.description:
Comprehensive Solutions for Corrosive Chemical Transfer
#

Our range of chemical transfer pumps, constructed from high-grade engineering plastics, is engineered to handle a wide spectrum of corrosive chemicals. These pumps are suitable for both indoor and covered outdoor environments, making them ideal for diverse industrial applications.

item.title: Advanced Solutions for Chemical Filtration in Industrial Applications
item.description:
Advanced Solutions for Chemical Filtration in Industrial Applications
#

Filtration is a vital component in many chemical processes, especially when dealing with corrosive or hazardous substances. Traditional plastic filters designed for water or metallic filter chambers are often unsuitable for these demanding environments. To address these challenges, our fully plastic chemical filters are engineered specifically to withstand aggressive chemicals, ensuring both operational safety and durability.

item.title: Ensuring Pump Reliability with Monitoring and Protection Solutions
item.description:
Ensuring Pump Reliability with Monitoring and Protection Solutions
#

The pump serves as the core of any circulating or fluid transfer system, playing a vital role in maintaining operational efficiency. Given the presence of numerous moving parts, it is essential not only to have a robust structural design but also to implement effective monitoring and protection mechanisms. This approach helps prevent abnormal operations and detects early signs of wear, ultimately extending the lifespan of the equipment and reducing costly downtime.

item.title: Accredited Pump Performance Testing for Reliable Results
item.description:
Accredited Pump Performance Testing for Reliable Results
#

ASSOMA’s Pump Performance Test Laboratory stands as the first in Taiwan to receive accreditation from the Taiwan Accreditation Foundation (TAF) under ISO 17025, fully compliant with ISO 9906 standards. Our laboratory is dedicated to providing fast, reliable, and internationally recognized pump performance testing services, supporting customers in verifying product quality and enhancing their competitive edge.
